resources.string: TakeBack Accessibility Service detects when restricted applications or distracting websites are opened and displays your custom focus shield.
Shows active distraction protection and scheduled focus state.
Enables TakeBack to deter unauthorized changes, settings tampering, and casual uninstallation while Strict Mode is active.
Warning: Deactivating TakeBack Device Administrator compromises your active Strict Mode protections, allowing profiles and restrictions to be bypassed. Are you sure you want to proceed?

Warning: TakeBack Strict Mode is currently ACTIVE. Deactivating Device Administrator will compromise your restrictions and mark protection status as compromised. To modify settings legitimately, authenticate within TakeBack first.
Disabling TakeBack\'s Accessibility Service halts real-time application limits and website blocking. Strict Mode is protecting this service from premature disabling.
Deactivating TakeBack\'s Device Administrator removes anti-tamper and uninstallation protection. Strict Mode requires verification to modify this setting.
Modifying TakeBack\'s application settings, clearing storage, or force-stopping the application is blocked while Strict Mode is active.
